第60章 暴揍赵瞎子-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

"哎呦，青山，你这是打了两只野猪吗，这么多肉？"

“你不说我还没注意到，这么多肉，得有七百多斤吧？”

“我打小就看青山这小子行，一上山就打到这么多野物，真是厉害啊！”

“咱们村，已经很久没人打到这么多野物了吧？”

“哎呦，还有一只活着的香獐子，这怎么抓到的？”

“青山，好手段啊！”

周围村民这才将目光放在了抬回来的猎物上，脸上纷纷流露出一抹赞许之色，当然其中也不乏有些人心生嫉妒，看着那一块块肥硕的猪肉，眼睛都红了。

“切，有什么了不起的，不就是运气好吗，我就不信，他能次次运气都这么好？”

“就是，不就是打了两只野猪吗？那是我没上山，我要是上山，肯定打的比这个还要多。”

“娘的，李青山这小子运气怎么这么好，这运气要是放在我身上，这次我回来肯定能带回来七八只野猪。”

村子里的几个二流子还有眼红的，纷纷凑在一起，一脸不爽的盯着李青山，恨不得将李青山都给生吞活剥。

凭啥啊！

这小子一上山，就能抓到这么多的野物啊？

“你们几个小崽子有种到我跟前说！”

李青山凶狠的目光朝着这伙人狠狠望了过去，刚刚还在冷嘲热讽的这群人，瞬间闭上了嘴巴，只是努力找补道：“我们说啥了，我们就是说你运气好，又没骂你！”

“就是，李青山，你不能没事找事吧？”

“青山，你怎么还在这待着呢，你家出事了！”就在这时，村子里的富贵匆匆跑了过来，开口提醒道。

“什么？”

“怎么回事？”

李青山心中顿时升起一抹不祥的预感，语气焦急道。

“赵瞎子堵在你们家门口正在骂街呢，你嫂子骂不过，现在都躲在房子里哭，赵瞎子还说你死了。”

富贵一路跑过来，气喘吁吁道。

“娘的，这赵瞎子是想死了吧？”

李青山眼神中顿时升起一抹怒火，匆匆朝着家的方向跑了过去，其他村民见有热闹可以看，纷纷也跟着去了。

娘的，什么时候，这种阿猫阿狗都敢骑在自己脖子上拉屎了？

"Hey, Qingshan, did you kill two wild boars? There is so much meat?"

"Don't tell me that I haven't noticed that there is so much meat, it must weigh more than 700 kilograms, right?"

"I've been watching this kid from Qingshan since I was a kid. He hunted down so many wild animals as soon as he went up the mountain. It's really amazing!"

"No one in our village has hunted so many wild animals for a long time, right?"

"Hey, there is also a living fragrant deer. How did you catch it?"

"Qingshan, what a trick!"

The surrounding villagers then focused their attention on the prey that was brought back, with a look of approval on their faces. Of course, some of them were jealous, and their eyes turned red when they looked at the fat pieces of pork.

"Tch, what's so great? Isn't it just good luck? I don't believe that he can be so lucky every time?"

"That's right, didn't I just kill two wild boars? That's because I didn't go up the mountain. If I had gone up the mountain, I would have killed more than this."

"Damn, why is this boy Li Qingshan so lucky? If this luck were on me, I would definitely be able to bring back seven or eight wild boars this time."

Several second-rate and jealous people in the village gathered together and stared at Li Qingshan with unhappy expressions, wishing to eat Li Qingshan alive.

Why!

How can this kid catch so many wild animals as soon as he goes up the mountain?

"You little brats, come to me and tell me!"

Li Qingshan looked fiercely at this group of people. The group of people who were still sarcastic just now closed their mouths and tried to make up for it: "What did we say? We just said you were lucky and we didn't scold you!"

"That's right, Li Qingshan, you can't just look for trouble, right?"

"Qingshan, why are you still here? Something happened to your family!" At this moment, the rich man in the village hurried over and reminded him.

"What?"

"What's going on?"

An ominous premonition suddenly arose in Li Qingshan's heart, and he spoke anxiously.

"Blind Zhao is blocking the door of your house and cursing. Your sister-in-law cannot scold you. Now she is hiding in the house crying. Blind Zhao even said that you are dead."

Fugui ran all the way over, panting.

"Damn it, does this blind Zhao want to die?"

A flash of anger suddenly rose in Li Qingshan's eyes, and he hurried towards his home. Seeing that there was a lot of fun to watch, other villagers also followed.

Damn it, when did such a cat and dog dare to sit on my neck and shit?
